name: open_close_clear_flags
query: SELECT flag, count(*) AS n, min(date) AS first, max(date) AS last FROM OPEN ON 2016-01-01 CLOSE ON 2017-01-01 CLEAR GROUP BY flag ORDER BY flag
notes: Counts and dates of the synthetic postings per flag: S (summarization, 2015-12-31), C (conversions, 2016-12-31) and T (transfers, 2016-12-31), next to the real '*' postings. Also sensitive to whether zhang's synthetic balance-check transactions (zero-amount postings) are part of the postings table.
